public.prompt: Fill the missing proof of a controller's signed output condition. Read the immutable formal statement F, its variable count and goal literal. Supply a resolution refutation of F plus the negated goal, AND a concrete satisfying model of F. This establishes the stated conclusion without exploiting inconsistent assumptions. Use the exact statement digest; changing or weakening the theorem is invalid. Only compact proof-index triples are accepted; no source code, new premises, admitted axioms or prose proofs. The task is finite propositional logic and is not a Lean or physical-control evaluation.

statement_sha256.description: Exact SHA256 from the fixed public formal statement.

proof_steps.description: Resolution steps [left_index,right_index,pivot]; max 12000 steps and protocol size bound.

consistency_model.description: Exactly 43 Boolean values satisfying the ORIGINAL premises F.

check_prefix.description: Check at most 256 proposed resolution steps; never solve or complete the proof

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
